versions.changelog:
- SKILL.md fully translated to Chinese, replacing the English version with a detailed bilingual workflow and usage guide.
- No changes to core functionality or interface; documentation localization only.
- Added GitHub Actions workflow file: .github/workflows/codeql.yml.
- Removed metadata/landing content file: skill-card.md.
- All workflow instructions, references, and best practice notes are now in Chinese.

Initial public release with a comprehensive diagram creation, replication, and refinement workflow for research and technical figures.

- Added all core scripts, documentation, and assets for Draw.io/diagrams.net diagram building.
- Bundled a full icon library (Tabler SVG icons).
- Included extensive documentation on workflow, style extraction, reference replication, and XML authoring.
- Provided quality checks, preview/validation scripts, and Windows-safe draw.io preview support.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md in favor of unified README and SKILL docs.

drawio-diagram-builder 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Enables creation, editing, replication, and iterative refinement of editable diagrams in diagrams.net/draw.io (.drawio XML) format from diverse inputs.
- Introduces detailed prerequisite checks for Python, browser automation, vision tools, internet, and file access.
- Describes a priority-ordered toolchain for robust diagram generation, preview, and screenshot feedback loops.
- Documents comprehensive workflows and mandatory protocols for diagram intake, style extraction, and high-fidelity reference replication.
